spec_match.rationale: Classifies real target attributes against the four keywords, declared frame names and underscore-reserved names, plus a live "_notakeyword" proof.

interactive.rationale: Editable markup, Audit, Restore and the live proof button all work (Audit re-renders the same table for the unchanged sample).

edge_cases.rationale: Covers case variants and reserved underscore names, but its copy for _CURRENT says it will navigate a frame named _current; frame names are matched case-sensitively, and the keywords sweep shows nothing moved for _CURRENT.

references.rationale: Now links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5121089536262144 (id verified against the feature index and the chromestatus API: 'Remove non-standard navigations targeted at _current').

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 4/4 PASS on reflection/name/targetable-element contracts; the behavioural removal itself is proven by the which-frame-actually-moved harness rather than the suite.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): 10 targets, 4 flagged; proof frame navigated; console clean; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: Telemetry loads, but navigating harness frames aborts their in-flight beacons: POST /telemetry/demo returned 400 ("Cannot read request body") 1-2 times per run.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

guidanceConsulted.query: iframe navigation target and link accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give iframes accessible titles, keep native buttons/links, and announce results textually.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Observed: harness frames are titled and the result is restated as text in a status region and a frame-state table; iframe focus stops have no visible ring (browser default for frames).
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "iframe navigation target and link accessibility" (run 2026-11-15)

summary: Critique-only pass. Loaded http://localhost:3109/v153/remove-non-standard-navigations-targeted-at-current/auditing-your-own-targets/ in Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass), clicked/changed every visible control, captured console errors and failed requests, checked 360px horizontal overflow and a Tab focus walk, and ran /v153/remove-non-standard-navigations-targeted-at-current/conformance/ (unflagged, and with the relevant --enable-blink-features flag where one exists). Non-minor work items are listed in openQuestions. Fix pass (goal-setting, 2026-11-15): verified in Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass) against a local server, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, with and without the relevant --enable-blink-features flag; every visible control clicked/tapped, 0 horizontal overflow, no console errors. The _current verdict now says the name is case-sensitive after the removal and that a differently-cased spelling would not match a frame named _current.
